articles.title: No sanctuary safe in Pak, India will choose time of strike: Armed Forces
articles.summary: India's top military brass, on the first anniversary of a major operation (likely Balakot), asserted that no terrorist sanctuary in Pakistan is safe. They affirmed India's preparedness to strike all targets at a time and in a manner of its choosing. This statement underscores India's resolute stance against cross-border terrorism and its strategic autonomy in counter-terrorism responses, reinforcing a proactive defence posture.

articles.title: kengo kuma’s first US museum emerges within vast art and nature campus in pennsylvania
articles.summary: Renowned architect Kengo Kuma & Associates has unveiled the design for its first museum building in the United States. This significant project is part of a major expansion for the Brandywine Conservancy, marking Kuma's inaugural museum structure on American soil. The development represents a notable addition to the US architectural and cultural landscape, highlighting international design contributions.
